description: 5-class no-seatbelt variant. Unified label 5 (seatbelt) is dropped from every split, source and target, before any loader is built; the head is 5-wide.
rationale: DMD and 3MDAD have no seatbelt in ground truth, so the submitted 6-wide head carries a class those targets can never exhibit. This arm removes the asymmetry rather than reporting around it.
verified_by: tools/dry_construct.py -> head [5,768], model.num_classes=5, domain head 2; red side: requesting 3 returns a 3-wide head
note: Labels 0-4 stay contiguous when 5 is dropped, so no remap is needed; DropClassDataset asserts this.
